name: Linkding Plus
description: A self-hosted bookmark manager designed to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up. (Includes feature for archiving websites as HTML snapshots)
composeYaml:
services:
  linkding-plus:
    image: 'sissbruecker/linkding:latest-plus'
    volumes:
      - 'linkding_data:/etc/linkding/data'
    environment:
      - 'LD_SUPERUSER_NAME=${LINKDING_USER}'
      - 'LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=${LINKDING_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "bash -c ':> /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9090' || exit 1"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
